title: Language-Conditional Dequantization: Recovering What Quantization Steals from Non-English Languages
abstract: arXiv:2608.11786v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Aggressive quantization disproportionately harms multilingual capability: in the sub-4B INT3 GPTQ regime, we measure 2-4x larger perplexity degradation on non-English languages than on English. We propose Language-Conditional Dequantization (LCD), a post-hoc method that attaches per-language rank-2 LoRA corrections to the linear layers of an already-quantized model, adding 0.12% parameters per language and training in under 20 minutes on a single GPU. translated_title: 语言条件去量化：恢复量化从非英语语言中窃取的信息
translated_abstract: 摘要：激进的量化对多语言能力造成了不成比例的损害：在低于4B参数规模的INT3 GPTQ设置下，我们测量到非英语语言的困惑度退化比英语大2-4倍。我们提出了语言条件去量化（LCD），一种事后方法，将每语言秩为2的LoRA修正附加到已量化模型的线性层上，每语言仅增加0.12%的参数，并在单个GPU上训练不到20分钟。在Qwen2.5-3B和Llama-3.2-3B上，LCD恢复了非拉丁文字语言70-83%的困惑度差距，以及GlobalMMLU准确率差距的17-28%，在类型学上遥远的语言上比同等容量的语言无关修正高出3-9个百分点，并且比无数据的低秩基线（LQER）高出一个数量级。我们还发现了一个困惑度-准确率脱节现象，并将其追溯到量化集中损害的位置：早期深度错误（Llama）会传播到下游并加剧。
tldr: 本文提出语言条件去量化（LCD）方法，通过为量化模型附加每语言低秩修正，有效恢复非英语语言的性能损失，显著优于语言无关基线。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Language-Conditional Dequantization (LCD), which attaches per-language low-rank corrections to quantized models to recover performance loss in non-English languages, significantly outperforming language-agnostic baselines.
